cohort: The study analyzed a total sample of 1,805 nonpregnant women of reproductive age (WRA) from Lahore, Pakistan.
finding: The prevalence of overweight and obesity among reproductive-aged women in Lahore was nearly 50%, with factors such as wealth quintile, marital status, age, and occupational status significantly associated with the risk.
cross-section timing: Data was collected as part of the National Nutritional Survey (NNS) 2018.
